cd /Users/vitaliy/Documents/GitHub/local-whisper
git add -A
git commit -q -F - <<'MSG'
Restore the streaming pipeline: transcribe while recording continues

A three-minute dictation waited three minutes and then started transcribing.
Segments were only dispatched after the key came up, so the wait scaled with
the recording instead of with the tail.

The pipeline existed once -- ac208cc, "streaming pipeline: transcribe
segments live during recording" -- and was deleted in ac4c275, the same
dead-features cleanup that took splitAtSilence. Restored and adapted: API
mode, the progress bar and the 55s silence split all postdate the original.

streamCheckAndDispatch() polls every 3s while recording. Once more than
FINAL_SEGMENT_SECS of unclaimed chunks exist, it hands splitAtSilence's first
pause-bounded group to whisper immediately; doFinalTranscription() is left
with only the tail. Results are keyed by segment number, so segments that
finish out of order still concatenate in order.

The guard is strictly `> FINAL_SEGMENT_SECS`: at exactly that many chunks
splitAtSilence returns the whole list as its trailing "everything remaining"
group, which is not a silence-bounded cut and is still growing.

Measured first, because this feature could quietly undo the capture fix: with
two whisper-cli runs overlapping a live recording, every chunk still came out
exactly 1.000000s and the recorder reported 49.63s over ~50s of wall clock.
AVAudioEngine's input tap is real-time scheduled and Metal work does not
starve it.

emergencyStop() now resets the pipeline, otherwise segments already
transcribed would still be assembled and pasted a moment after the user asked
it to stop. pipelineReset is forward-declared above emergencyStop -- the
pipeline itself must be defined below insertTranscribedText, and the `scope`
check caught the nil-global that the naive ordering produced.

Tests: 92 pass, 5 new `pipeline` checks. Verified by mutation that they fail
on the three bugs that matter -- audio dropped (nextChunk +1), audio
transcribed twice (nextChunk -1), and live dispatch silently reverting to
transcribe-after-release.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
